camp to
improve her skills. She's fresh

and has a smile on
her face.

text_block_list.text: Your love is what got me through it. ♪

text_block_list.text: Your love is what got me through it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...It's not long until the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.text:

out way
stronger! ♪
